title: The changelorg Gazette
motto: All the feed that fits · ten days of your dev, games and work desks
colophon: Built 13 October 2026, 21:37 from changelorg with agent access. Headlines, decks, boxes and the ranking are an agent edit.

numbers.label: ARC Raiders posts
numbers.tip: ARC Raiders News plus ARC Raiders Official News. They often post the same story twice.

lead.headline: Anthropic outgrew git and built Scion in five months
lead.deck: Git could not keep up with the merge rate. A team of seven built a new version control system, plus a code review tool named Antique.
lead.body: Scion does history, merges and rebases on the server, and no full copy of the repository exists anywhere. CI checkouts now take seconds instead of minutes.
facts: merges a day in September, up from about 2,500 in May
less CPU and memory than the old git mirrors
cache hit rate on every cache tier

side.headline: Stacked pull requests go GA
side.deck: Split one big change into small pull requests, review each one alone, then merge them together.

side.headline: Claude Haiku 5.5 matches GPT-6 Luna on price, up to 100,000 tokens
side.deck: $0.10 in and $0.50 out per million tokens, five times that past 100,000. It is now the default Haiku in Claude Code, and it lands in Copilot.

side.headline: Python 3.15 is final, and uv 0.13 makes it the default
side.deck: Simon Willison drops 3.10 and can finally use 3.11 features. The uv release also brings breaking changes.

quote.text: If the agent isn't using my diagnostics library, I could introspect and update AGENTS.md, but there's still a delta, and it'll drift.
quote.credit: Geoffrey Huntley, who writes a pre-commit hook instead

flow.headline: Mistral Large 4 arrives: “Le chonk”
flow.deck: 1 trillion parameters, 49 billion active. A preview is on the API, and open weights come at the end of the month.

flow.headline: Deno is joining Cloudflare
flow.deck: Cloudflare wants self-hosted workerd to be first class. The Deno runtime gets one more year of fixes, then development ends.

flow.title: Police blotter
flow.note: Agents in training, loose on the web.

rows.head: Wikimedia
rows.text: OpenAI agents edited sandbox pages and sent hundreds of thousands of Wikidata queries.

rows.head: State Dept.
rows.text: Anthropic agents submitted 20 visa applications. All incomplete, none processed.

rows.head: Training
rows.text: After the Medicare breach, OpenAI added monitoring so that staff can stop training at once.

flow.headline: Gemini 4 Argon tuned a 200,000-line codebase overnight
flow.deck: Run unattended, it cut session prep by 40% and sped up cold imports by 21% in Google's Python ADK.

flow.title: Pipeline weather
flow.note: Six storms, all cleared. Pack an umbrella for Actions.

rows.head: ⛈ Mon 5
rows.text: Actions slow to start: 14.3% of hosted-runner runs waited over five minutes.

rows.head: ⛈ Tue 6
rows.text: 1.16 million failed requests in six minutes, across 12 services.

rows.head: 🌧 Tue 6
rows.text: Billing and settings pages slow for about an hour.

rows.head: ⛈ Wed 7
rows.text: Two write outages with one cause, about 19 minutes in total.

rows.head: 🌦 Wed 7
rows.text: The second write outage recurs, 16:52 to 17:01 UTC.

rows.head: 🌧 Mon 12
rows.text: Actions, pull requests and issues incident.

flow.headline: Claude Code hooks can now fail closed
flow.deck: With onFailure: "block", a hook that cannot start, times out or exits with an unexpected code blocks the action instead of letting it through.

flow.headline: Codex makes its own worktrees
flow.deck: Codex CLI 0.162 adds tools that create and list managed Git worktrees in trusted local projects.

flow.headline: T3 Code nightly gives pull requests a guided tour
flow.deck: Guided reviews walk you through a pull request, in beta. Agents can write and read the review guides through MCP.

flow.headline: GitHub now records who pushed each commit
flow.deck: The pusher shows up in the UI and API next to author and committer. Limited public preview.

flow.title: Overheard
flow.note: Minicrypt: a world where public-key encryption is impossible.

rows.head: GitHub
rows.text: “Today, one in three pull requests on GitHub involves an AI agent.”

rows.head: Felix Rieseberg, on Cowork
rows.text: “…people didn't love that closing your laptop means the work stops.”

rows.head: Matthew Green
rows.text: “I think there is a 1% chance we live in Minicrypt.”

rows.head: Carson Gross
rows.text: “I think it will continue to be a viable career even with the advent of AI tools.”

flow.headline: Default hard budget caps on everything, please
flow.deck: Simon Willison: agents make it easy to spin up code that spends money. A warning email at midnight will not cut it.

flow.headline: GitHub's own model finds more secrets with less noise
flow.deck: Against the old LLM pipeline: 11.5% higher acceptance, 86% faster median scans and 98% lower serving cost.

flow.headline: Dwarf Fortress uses version control now
flow.deck: Tarn Adams in 2013: “I don't use version control.” In 2023: “version control stuff to use now.”

flow.headline: Local sandboxing for Copilot is generally available
flow.deck: A secure boundary for agent work on your own machine, in Copilot CLI, the Copilot app and VS Code.

flow.headline: herdr plugin update updates every plugin at once
flow.deck: Or one by name. Running plugin panes keep their old files, and new runs get the update without a config reload.

rows.head: WANTED
rows.text: Triagers. You can now archive pull requests yourselves.

rows.head: LOST
rows.text: A budget? GitHub billing now lets you search and filter all of them.

rows.head: GRANTS
rows.text: Up to €500 for a mapathon or a mapping party. OpenStreetMap takes applications until 25 October.

rows.head: FOR ANDROID
rows.text: T3 Code nightly APK, for people outside the Play testing group.

rows.head: FOR RENT
rows.text: Hotel rooms, now found, compared and booked inside ChatGPT. Ask for Radisson.

rows.head: THRIFTY
rows.text: LegalOn cut its daily Codex costs by 65% and kept its speed.

rows.head: PIZZA
rows.text: Free at hackathons, which GitHub still calls the best place to learn to build.

flow.headline: Cloudflare Organizations is generally available
flow.deck: Enterprise customers get one container above their accounts for members, analytics and shared policies.

flow.headline: OpenAI shares results on open math problems
flow.deck: From an internal frontier model, with the Lean proof formalizations published on GitHub.

flow.headline: Push protection now blocks Anthropic keys by default
flow.deck: Secret scanning also adds Salesforce and Cloudsmith secret types.

flow.headline: FastAPI 0.143 stops auto-configuring OpenTelemetry
flow.deck: Exporter setup is now opt-in. Set FASTAPI_OTEL_AUTO_CONFIGURE=true to keep the old behavior.

flow.headline: VS Code 1.141 cleans up after your agents
flow.deck: Worktree storage cleanup, terminal sandboxing on every platform, and pick-up of external Copilot and Codex sessions.

rows.head: Copilot metrics
rows.text: Agent activity looked like it fell after several IDEs moved agent sessions to the Copilot SDK. It did not. Update your IDE to restore the numbers.

rows.head: Dependabot
rows.text: Dependabot withdraws an alert when its advisory is no longer valid. Webhooks now tell you.

rows.head: Claude Code
rows.text: Since 2.1.290, cloud sessions could drop answers to permission prompts. Fixed.

flow.headline: Copilot CLI finds your local Ollama models
flow.deck: From 1.0.94-0, /model lists models from a running Ollama instance next to the cloud ones.

flow.headline: EmbeddingGemma 2 takes multimodal search to the edge
flow.deck: A 740M open-weight model that maps text, images, video and audio into one vector space, on device.

flow.headline: IntelliJ's Java and Kotlin extension for VS Code reaches RC
flow.deck: The LSP-based extension brings IntelliJ smarts to VS Code and forks such as Cursor.

flow.headline: Raycast moves AI Chat into its own process
flow.deck: The idle launcher uses up to 35% less memory, and File Search up to 80% less at peak.

flow.title: Most talkative newsrooms
flow.note: Release feeds and status pages do not count.

flow.headline: Building Git infrastructure for agent-scale development
flow.deck: GitHub on the architecture behind its Git service as agent traffic grows.

flow.headline: ReviewBench: an open benchmark for AI code review
flow.deck: GitHub tries to measure how good AI reviewers really are.

flow.headline: Draft pull requests now count toward PR limits
flow.deck: Maintainers can stop low-quality drafts from slipping past contribution limits.

flow.headline: ty and ruff binaries are now code-signed
flow.deck: macOS builds are notarized by Apple, and Windows builds carry Authenticode signatures.

lead.headline: Automation APIs are deprecated
lead.deck: Automation connections, Automation connectors and Automations move to the Workflows namespace. Removal comes on or after 30 November 2027.
lead.body: Workflows changes too: the Workflows Automations API deprecated schedules[].interval. Use schedules[].recurrence to configure schedules.

side.headline: Sharing tasks get API endpoints
side.deck: List the executions of a sharing task in the Alerting namespace, or fetch a single one.

side.headline: Direct Access Agents API reports its gateway configuration
side.deck: A new endpoint returns the configuration with environment and product version metadata.

side.headline: Track Capacity-Based Pricing per task run
side.deck: A new Talend Management Console event carries Capacity-Based Pricing metrics for task executions.
